resumen: Three days a week alternating A and B with machines and cables: leg press, leg extension and curl, pulldown, cable row, and Smith machine bench press and squat. Machines set the path, which simplifies technique when starting out.
matices: In an eight-week study, biceps and quadriceps muscle thickness increased equally with machines and free weights; for strength, the machine group improved more on the machine bench press (13.9% vs 8.6%). Machines are therefore a reasonable way to start; moving to free weights later means learning their technique. Alternating A and B, each muscle is trained twice a week, which reviews link with slightly more gain than once. Adjust each machine before the first set: the seat and pads determine how the joint works.
